{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year = 2015}}
{{main article|2015 World Table Tennis Championships}}

[[Li Xiaoxia]] was the defending champion but lost in the semifinals.<ref>[http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_wttc_web2.asp?Gender=W&Tour_ID=2503&Singles=1 Entry list]</ref>

[[Ding Ning]] captured the title by defeating [[Liu Shiwen]] with 7–11, 15–13, 11–7, 11–9, 9–11, 4–11, 11–8.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/_front_page/ittf_full_story1.asp?ID=39530&Competition_ID=2503&|title=Now a Living Legend, Injured Ding Ning Regains Title in Dramatic Final|date=2 May 2015|work=ittf.com}}</ref>

==Seeds==
Matches were best of 7 games in qualification and in the 128-player sized main draw.<ref>[http://www.ittf.com//World_Events/wttc_2015/Playing%20system_WTTC2015.pdf Playing system]</ref><ref>[http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_wttc_web2.asp?Gender=W&Tour_ID=2503&Singles=1&Seeded_Singles=1 Seeds]</ref>
